component.name: Lithium Studio
component.summary: Make music with an easy, friendly studio

description.p: Lithium Studio is a beginner-friendly music studio. Pick a sound, play it on the on-screen keyboard or a MIDI keyboard, and arrange regions on a timeline. It stays simple by default, with advanced controls tucked away until you ask for them.

ul.li: Instrument tracks with a built-in synthesizer
MIDI regions, loop playback and a metronome
Sound controls, effects and a simple mixer
Works the same on Linux, Windows and macOS

description.p: New knobs and faders: machined metal knobs with a tick scale, and console-style faders with ribbed caps, in both the dark and light themes. The track volume sliders and the master volume have the same caps.
Softer instrument colors that sit with the Lithium look, a new Manage Sounds window laid out like Lithium Drums' kit browser, and a new About window with up-to-date credits.

Ikaros Studio is now Lithium Studio, part of the Lithium family with Lithium Drums: a new name, icon and look (dark blue panels, cyan accent, the Lithium fonts, knobs, faders, meters and mixer strips), and richer instrument colors. Settings, sessions and sound packs move over on their own, and .iksession files still open.
New installers for Linux, Windows and macOS, and the sound packs now come from Lithium Sounds, with a Starter Sounds set the installer can download for you.
Fix release: the macOS window buttons stay in the title bar after leaving full screen, and plugging in a MIDI-only device no longer offers to switch audio to it.
Alpha release for milestone 14: native window buttons on macOS, working title bar on Windows.
Alpha release for milestone 13: performance fixes.
